platform_target.authority_boundary: Design target only; packaging, MSIX, WACK, Partner Center, certification, runtime and shipping authority remain Engineering/outside-lane.

director_decision: Stop treating human artwork completion as a prerequisite to app visual design.
Human artwork is not required for the current app UI direction.
Move now into concrete app-screen design and refine the visual system through iterative compositions and Director reaction.
Previously earned design law remains useful guardrails but must not prevent screen construction merely because final identity/color/type/artwork decisions remain open.

charart_disposition.reason: Director explicitly redirected Design away from human artwork and into app-screen design before CHARART post-render scoring/promotion.
charart_disposition.reentry: Do not resume human artwork unless a later Director instruction explicitly reopens it.

active_work.name: Windows 11 ARM64 Working App Visual Prototype
active_work.goal: Build visually coherent real app screens now, learn from composition/use, and refine the visual system as the product surface becomes concrete.

working_design_law: PKT-STAGE-CORE-02 remains exact Stage authority; APPUI-01 may frame/adjacent-compose around it but may not silently redesign its geometry/scenery.
CPS-B remains canonical Character-presence architecture, but portraits/human artwork are optional and not required for APPUI-01.
APPICON-01 E06 remains the current app-icon design-master envelope around exact C0; this creates no Store/package authority.
DUR-01 PASS remains evidence that the current bounded identity mechanisms survive reduction/accessibility stress.
CLR F2/F1 remains unselected. APPUI-01 may explore provisional color inside mockups without promoting a palette winner.
Provisional type/material/state/motion mechanisms may be used, simplified, or challenged in working screens; prototype use does not silently convert them to final authority.
Product semantics must come from current Product/Engineering authority or be labeled synthetic; APPUI-01 must not invent engine authority merely to fill a screen.
explicit_non_authority: No final WinUI/XAML control selection or native implementation claim.
No Microsoft Store certification, MSIX/package, WACK, Partner Center or shipping claim.
No final palette, typeface, symbol, wordmark, material system or Character artwork is created by this sequencing correction.
No Phase-D or Engineering/runtime authority is created.
